Three-level surgical-research wing in the Inevitable City (Blood Rift, Avernus). Dr. Maltheus's workspace. L1 the Concordance (comparative anatomy index); L2 the Theater (operating theater / Anchor Forge where anchors are cut open); L3 the Standing Problem (his study — books, leather chairs — with the unsolved Demiurge conversion proof written across the walls; two chairs face it, the second is Sania's). Names chosen to read as a surgeon's flat precision, not setting placards.
Dr. Maltheus character sheet build (25 May 2026). Inevitable City founding sessions.
None. Uncontrolled wilderness. No Sembian military presence — the Council considers the swamp a natural barrier, not territory worth garrisoning.

Marshland region south of Sembia between the Heartlands and Cormyr. Lair of an ancient black dragon running a centuries-old territorial protection racket on southern Sembian trade routes. Quest site for Nightwind's Acid Fang evolution. Terrain: flooded bogs, acidic pools, toxic gases, visibility-killing fog. The Magisterium Verbi may have operational ties to the dragon's territorial control.

No empire garrison. Operation Evening Star operates under Vesper Aldaine cover. Sembian municipal guard and mercenary companies provide security. Veil presence: 5 operatives embedded in Tessavere & Aldaine.

Sembia's largest port city (formerly Chancelgaunt). Pop ~56,000. Deep-water harbor at mouth of River Arkhen on Sea of Fallen Stars. Governed by the Old Chauncel (old noble merchant families: Uskevren, Foxmantle, Soargyl, Isterin). Hulorn is the ruling title. Was interim Sembian capital after Ordulin's destruction (~late 1300s–1499 DR). Survived Netherese/Shadovar occupation. Fashion and luxury capital of the Heartlands. Notable temples: Hallowed House of High Achievement (DENEIR — Magisterium Verbi institutional foothold), Firehair's House (Sune), House of Song (Milil), Palace of Holy Festivals (Lliira), Sanctum of the Scroll (Oghma). Operation Evening Star base — Lirien as Vesper Aldaine, Tessavere & Aldaine salon. Primary intelligence target: Oressa Talavera (Council Seat 6, Banking). Continental Waterway preferred eastern terminus.

Combined-arms Bloodaxe detachment (5th Redwall, 13th Black Anvil, 18th Vein Guard, 12th Grey Mantle) + Marine Corps det. + Wyrmhelm flight + Aevendrow auxiliaries + 1st-Circle mage pair + Moranth munitions team

Empire's sovereign ocean entrance for the Baen Continental Waterway. Purpose-built fortified harbor on the coast between Neverwinter and Leilon, connected to Forgedeep by canal through Neverwinter Wood. Eight-phase construction plan (1495-1503 DR). La Rochelle-model layered defenses: reef chain, southern headland, rock fort, breakwater arms, tower forts, chain boom, canal lock gate, contravallation. Status shifts to Controlled when Phase 1 construction begins.
Current: Goblin-occupied ruin. Planned: 80 soldiers + 40 estate staff (120 total, self-sustaining from demesne forest)

Originally a Phalorm wizard-noble's research castle (Seven overlapping round towers). Destroyed by foundation failure over 900 years — built on dirt without reaching bedrock. Currently occupied by goblins (Cragmaw Castle). Empire plan: clear goblins, full teardown and rebuild on bedrock with Roman concrete foundations, echo crystal mortar throughout. Transformed into retreat-fortress with Marly-style cascade water features, managed demesne forest, and canal lock integration. Status shifts to Controlled after goblin clearance.

Hammer 1495: Fortress Marshal Grimnar Doomhammer commands the installation; Major Jorik Tharn commands the ~500–550 personnel of the 5th Redwall Cohort and attached staff. Reservoir marines number ~40–80 while building toward 100. Hydraulic, power, communications, construction and support personnel are additional. Exact whole-site workforce remains pending.

GM-ready Hammer 1495 dam-fortress. Partially commissioned Grayflow works with active six-billion-gallon completed-state design, corrected pre-thaw storage doctrine, completed-state drought yield, reconciled project economics, separate H0–H3 hydraulic and S0–S3 security states, and no canonized active enemy. Grimnar Doomhammer commands the installation; Jorik Tharn commands Redwall; Hedra Stonewake holds independent hydraulic-safety authority and the Engineer's Key. Old Llorkh functions as the multi-thousand-person Works District. Scene grounding and keyed authoritative plate specifications are complete; exact workforce, Grayflow inundation atlas, Grimnar biography and turbine flow survey remain deferred.

Dock Ward bathhouse that fronts a drow surface-cell trafficking people DOWN into the Underdark; the cellar is an excavation for the Drowned Idol. One-session module, APL 8–10. Patron Peri (unsanctioned on her turf). Antagonist Naszra Dhaerryl. Hard clock: the Scuttle (collapse-and-flood failsafe over the holding cells). Stakes: free 14 adult captives before they drown with the evidence.
Site security detail; held under Bloodaxe forward-base posture (perimeter patrols, controlled road access) per Star Metal Hills caution.
Founding canon: Neverwinter Munitions Facility (Origin and Migration). Site canon: Treasury Stone Quarries (Business Registry). Canon-build backlog item 3.

Ruined capital of the fallen Sky-Veiled kingdom — DISTINCT from Akhet-Sereth (the Dawn Mother's older Mulhan capital, ~140yr dead, Hollow Reach religious-origin ruin) and from Akhet-Senet (the Thay-held Sun-Crowned Heights plateau, the campaign objective). Sky-Veiled = independent Mulan splinter kingdom, founded 922 DR by Mulan refugees fleeing Thay's secession from Mulhorand; stood ~506 years on its own strength in the High Country north of Thay; answered to no overlord (Mulhorand a distant cultural cousin, not a protector). Fell 1428 DR to Thay's second campaign when Mulhorand declined the aid Sky-Veiled appealed for. Akhet-Senef burned on the eighth-to-tenth days of the fall: Selvarra Sylphaire (Captain of the Lower City Defence) died at the Eastern Gate on the eighth day; the Ranger-General Sereth Sylphaire died defending the western tower on the tenth; eight-year-old Verissa hidden in the family compound's wine cellar, taken captive on the tenth. The Sylphaire lineage's seat for fourteen generations. Now Thay-overrun ruins in the High Country north of the Akhet-Senet plateau. Narrative potential: a Verissa or Allera pilgrimage, a Sylphaire-heritage recovery, the lineage's pre-exile records. None yet committed to canon.
Sylphaire family-triangle materials (Kara-Turan worldbuilding, 7 Jun 2026); created 18 Jun 2026 to resolve the Akhet-Sereth/Akhet-Senef capital conflation (Reading 1: two distinct kingdoms).

The living twilight demiplane of the star elves (Ruar-tel-quessir), raised by High Magic through the Yuirwood menhir circles. Distinct from Tir'in'tiral, the severed tomb-pocket. The empire has never contacted the living remnant — Naevaeris of House Velaris is the Door. Strategic value: planar-engineering knowledge (Mythallar Fragment Solution relevance), a star-born exodus, diplomatic legitimacy through House Velaris recognition.

Post-raid (Hammer 1495 DR): most of the ~30-strong Lolthite garrison (20 rank-and-file drow, 4 elite priestesses/officers, 6 giants) killed in the uprising. Vrishah'kahn the Patient (CR 11 yochlol) escaped gaseous and is recovering. 2 confirmed captives + ~12 unaccounted remain; the rector lost in the deep vault.

Severed tomb-pocket and hostile second-extraction target. 🔒 Ring Two escalation added 2026-07-26: Vrishah'kahn's reconstruction rituals summoned Selarial's Severing Ring; new shouted reporting protocol and Dispelling Procession are active. Detachment of the Bloodaxe Halfling Scout-Sniper Section ('The Quiet Company') — halfling shooter-spotter pairs on Threadbaum 1494-L 'Whisper' suppressed precision rifles running long-duration concealed observation posts over the Evermoors approaches — plus a standing rotation of 15 Bloodaxe legionaries providing perimeter watch and basic fortification security. Total garrison ~30.

Small Bloodaxe forward observation post on the Laughingflow (Trollflow) at the SW fringe of the Evermoors, north of Yartar. Quiet Company snipers + 15-man legionary rotation. Old Gnawbone waters at the Laughingflow's source lake — the redoubt sits in the nearest ancient wyrm's drinking range. Watched by Aldric Steelgaze (Ultimate Eye; 'whisper out of Yartar' per Operation Spindle) — live counter-intel clock. Forward observation point for the Arik/Selene/Ulthaxor dragon-capture campaign; column stages through en route north, transfers captures south to Isle de Troll for processing and underground hold.

Baen waystation at the Long Road junction 12 miles south of Yartar, first checkpoint on the Surbrin Eastern Road bypass. Duty clerk on Vara's payroll counts all traffic in two columns (commercial/maintenance); tenday report to Vara via crystal array. Not armed, not Veil. Three-day report delay in Mirtul 1495 is an open thread. Fourth Quiet Company counter-surveillance sweep scheduled.

72-foot 3x arterial bypassing Yartar. Branches off the Long Road 12 miles south of Yartar, runs 22 miles northeast to Isle de Troll, continues as 38-mile 36-foot Laughingflow extension to Trollflow Redoubt. Commercial cover: Surbrin Eastern Road filed by Vara Torsten. Crystal mortar array runs full length connecting to main Baen arterial network. Aldric Steelgaze has the road catalogued (width anomalous for stated purpose — provisionally deniable). Azurite accent slot built into all structures, stone deferred until road is operational.

~80 Bloodaxe legionaries on 90-day rotation posting (from existing cohorts, detached duty, classified station) + Quiet Company detachment (permanent tasking, does not rotate) + Sania Valmorra (permanent) + Yamilet al-Sevren (when column staged or capture in hold) + Volkmar Grimhand (commands when present). Gary permanently resident. Total at operational tempo ~130; surge capacity 300.

The Surbrin bypass crossing and underground dragon complex north of Yartar. Roman-style canal diversion creates a 320 x 1,200-foot island on the Surbrin. Two bridge spans (Home Bridge west over fire-oil pool; Hunt Bridge east over main canal). Three surface zones (west military, central citadel, east dragon). Two underground levels: Transfer Deck (lowering/assessment, Yamilet's working space, Sania's lab, dead-material vault, Gary's suite) and The Pit (THE CAGE, 220 x 140 ft floor, 55-ft ceiling, bedrock deck-spine anchors). Forbiddance ward covers entire dragon zone. Four personnel Shadow Gate nodes (near bank, island west, island central, far-bank tete-de-pont) plus the Well — a dragon-rated Sinker receiving hall in the western military zone (added 2026-09-04). 6-month larder at 300 persons. Aldric Steelgaze has the installation flagged (live counter-intel clock). Column home base; Trollflow Redoubt is the forward observation post.

The buried pre-Netherese throne hall of Dravakhsha the First-Crowned, beneath the flooded deep galleries of Fortress Llorkh (the Water Throne). Climax site for 'The First-Crowned's Claim' (Movements 6-7). A three-level descent: Level 1 the Lower Works (Baen concrete, the dam's flooded pump galleries, Pehlavan's ground); Level 2 the Breach (the seam where Baen concrete meets 8,000-year-old cut stone, the survey team's abandoned journal ending on 'the water is the only thing he is afraid of'); Level 3 the Drowned Hall (the throne, the clay tablet that anchors Dravakhsha, Marzban's stand, the first meeting and the convergence). The clock is physical: a rising waterline tracked through every room, footing becoming deep water, air-pockets shrinking. Win-condition and clock-failure are the same event — the tablet meets the water. Three endings leave the hall as tomb, empty throne, or the Neighbor's Hall (Dravakhsha alive). The Water Throne above was named for the wrong king. Designed, floating until earned; GM-only until discovered.
